name: 91723 · Covina, CA
findings: ZIP 91723 (Covina) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91723 (Covina) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91723 (Covina) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 69% of all organizations here have no identified type.
